game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Dune Crest Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the desert nomad must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: In Dune Crest, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round, sand wyrms strike the oasis, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the oasis from sand wyrms in Dune Crest: keep the boss_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: boss_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dune Crest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dune Crest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while boss_hp > 0.
